description: Given a list of players, report which bye weeks two or more of them share. Use this for roster planning and draft questions about stacking byes.
name: get_bye_conflicts

conflicts.description: One entry per week where two or more of the named players are out together. Empty when there are none.

refreshed_at.description: When this dataset was last refreshed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

season.description: The season these bye weeks belong to.

stats_season.description: The completed NFL season every figure in this result describes.

url.description: The draftcall.io page these figures came from. This is the citation to use.

title: Find bye-week conflicts on a roster
